import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0123.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)

cx,cy,h=-0.557,4.200,0.0

def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256./(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    return round(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0],3), round(cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1],3), round(D,2)
floor=(R>130)&(R<200)&(B<G)&((R-B)>10)
dark=(R<110)&(abs(R-G)<20)&(R>25)
for u in range(4,512,40):
    c=np.nonzero(floor[:,u])[0]; c=c[c>258]
    if len(c)>20: print('junc u',u,'v',c.min(),bp(u,c.min()))
print('--- dark right edge')
for u in [492,500,508,511]:
    c=np.nonzero(dark[:,u])[0]; c=c[(c>258)]
    if len(c): print(' u',u,'vtop',c.min(),'vbot',c.max(),bp(u,c.max()))
EOF
